units.source_text: 提起鼓励松叶食，以往形形色色的协会都乱提倡吃松叶、吃松叶，

en.t: When it comes to promoting a pine-needle diet, all sorts of associations in the past simply made a lot of noise about eating pine needles, eating pine needles,

units.source_text: 我们与他们大不相同，我们是真正采用了有价值的松叶精华。

en.t: but we are completely different from them: we have truly adopted the valuable essence of pine needles.

units.source_text: 本会顾问南方熊楠先生，大概诸位无人不知吧。

en.t: You all probably know Mr. Minakata Kumagusu, the adviser to our association.

units.source_text: 不胜惶恐，他是位给王室讲植物学的先生，无疑是一位相当了不起的人物。

en.t: I say this with great reverence: he is a gentleman who lectures the royal family on botany, and he is without doubt a truly remarkable person.

units.source_text: 前些日子，王室去九州的时候，首先请来南方先生，

en.t: Some time ago, when the royal family went to Kyushu, they first invited Mr. Minakata to come,

units.source_text: 亲切地握住他的手说：南方先生，听说你是世界级的学者。

en.t: warmly took his hand, and said, Mr. Minakata, I hear you are a world-class scholar.

units.source_text: 此前也不时要授予博士称号、男爵称号的，他都表示谢绝了。

en.t: Before that, too, people had at times tried to confer a doctorate or a barony on him, but he declined them all.

units.source_text: 对于像先生这样过着神仙般的生活的人来说，博士称号、男爵称号实际上是没有什么价值的。

en.t: For someone like him, living almost like an immortal sage, titles such as doctor or baron in fact have little value.

units.source_text: 对先生来说，除了学问以外没有财富，也没有权势。

en.t: For him, apart from scholarship, there is no wealth and no power.

units.source_text: 这样伟大的先生多年隐居在纪州的深山里进行研究，

en.t: This great man spent many years living in seclusion deep in the mountains of Kishu, carrying out his research,

units.source_text: 结果发表出来的就是鼓励这种松叶食。

en.t: and the result he published was this very encouragement of a pine-needle diet.

units.source_text: 松叶中含有大量人体所需的维生素ABC。

en.t: Pine needles contain large amounts of vitamins A, B, and C, which the human body needs.

units.source_text: 但是，迄今的松叶食鼓励者净乱叫乱喊要吃松叶，

en.t: However, until now, promoters of the pine-needle diet have done nothing but shout recklessly that people should eat pine needles,

units.source_text: 却懒得去研究它的食用方法，而松叶的精华部分，只有它的根部变白的部分。

en.t: while neglecting to study how they should be eaten; yet the true essence of the pine needle is only the white part at its base.
